notes.title: despelote now available on mac!
notes.content:
[p]hi! i have a few things to tell you about but the main thing is:[/p][p]
[b]despelote is now available on mac! [/b][/p][p][/p][p]the mac experts at panic helped us get a build ready. if you had been waiting for that to play it, now is your moment![/p][p][/p][p]next, i wanted to show off some pictures of a special "screening" we did of the game in ecuador a couple of months ago. even though the core team that made despelote was very small, so many people helped us along the way and we wanted to thank everyone by inviting them to watch the whole game played live at a movie theater. plus, there was a little bonus show from sebastian who played some songs from the game soundtrack live! [/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43839262/8bb030ca29adea79edfb3091ece2cbda8e916010.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43839262/3257dfc32b99cad742a79408990ca5ca035116b7.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43839262/7b8af37baf663728d6fc5c68d32bedad6267044a.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43839262/32b436c0ded0cd20abd0f509da7598871b59ffdb.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43839262/21dcaa37e6c6b50fa0636859964c2ab8c807d3be.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p]sebastian and ian have been mixing the soundtrack together and it is almost ready for release. they've done a wonderful job integrating the music from the game with the ambiences we recorded in ecuador and i'm really excited for everyone to hear it.[/p][p][/p][p]finally, just a quick update on the nintendo switch release. we've been working very hard to optimize the game to run as smooth as possible on switch, and it is almost ready. we don't have a date to announce yet, but we hope we will very soon. so stay tuned!

that's all for now![/p][p]- julián[/p]

notes.title: New Patch - Tino Tini's Soccer 99' Freeplay Mode + Scene Select Menu
notes.content: [p]Hi! [/p][p]We released a new patch for the game a few days ago. The patch includes a bunch of bug fixes, plus two new features:[/p][p][/p][h3]Tino Tini's Soccer 99' freeplay mode:[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43839262/61efd76e94dd2b8c9f2a730c3294c42ac18b4532.png"][/img]You can now play the soccer minigame over and over! Select your favorite country from the South American Qualifiers (Ecuador I hope) and play as long as you want. Each country has a different difficulty level so try to beat them all![/p][p]And, if you connect a second controller, you can play locally against a friend![/p][p][/p][h3]Scene Selection Mode:[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43839262/42f46fd50c4189bd555df91cefab725659e98cc0.png"][/img]You can now jump in to any scene in the game directly, so you can easily relive your favorite moments or find interactions you missed. Also, you can now skip the cutscenes if you want to go straight to the gameplay.[/p][p][/p][p]In order to access these two extra modes, you have to finish the game first! However, I must sadly confess that I forgot to track whether players finished the game already in the original release build (sorry!), so if you want to access these modes just [u][b]press start (or escape) 5 times when the logos appear after the game launches[/b][/u][b],[/b] and a new option in the title menu will appear.[/p][p][/p][h3]Full patch notes:[/h3][list][*][p]New feature: Tino Tini's Soccer 99' freeplay mode[/p][/*][*][p]New feature: Scene Selection Mode[/p][/*][*][p]Accessibility feature: option to toggle the sprint button to run.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: weird case where ball outside of stadium in Tino Tini dream was lost[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: ball getting stuck in corner of goal in soccer match dream.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: teacher teleports out of class if you arrive back after he arrives.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: windows look more like windows now hopefully[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: grey box on watch font when playing on lower resolutions[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: teens can push you into the dog giving birth hut and there is no escape[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: sister gets locked in at La Liebre while playing hide and seek and you can’t progress the day.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: if u fall in first dream u get the child animation/sound[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: credits broken when playing in chinese[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Y-axis inversion don’t apply to cutscenes[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: friends can get stuck in the lightbox in the final scene[/p][/*][/list][p]Finally, we wanted to thank everyone who has played the game so far and has been writing such kind words about it in steam reviews and other other internet places. We put our hearts and souls into the game for so long and it is so encouraging to see people connect with it so deeply now. Thanks![/p]

notes.title: despelote is out now + a Firewatch bundle! ⚽
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

[b]despelote is out now! Feels good to finally say that. [/b] 🙂 

The game is up on steam for $14.99 with a 10% launch discount AND if you own Firewatch, the fine folks at Campo Santo and Panic worked with us to get a launch bundle up where you can take advantage of an additional 10% off if you own Firewatch. Simply choose to complete your Firewatch + despelote bundle on the game’s page or by clicking below. 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/53234/

[b]Also as a reminder, your save from the demo will transfer over to the main game, so choose to continue your last save or start over, whichever you prefer. 
[/b]
That’s all from us! If you like what you played please leave us a Steam review - [b]they really matter for visibility! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43839262/f0525ee2e1b379c8c121fcc04251b92a127747f7.png[/img]

[b]Take care
- the despelote team 
[/b]

notes.title: ⚽ despelote is coming May 1st - Demo out now!
notes.content:
Hello. This has been a long time coming.. despelote is coming May 1st! [b]Check out our new trailer celebrating the news[/b]! 🎉  

[previewyoutube=vevpN9A6Z8o;full][Trailer] [/previewyoutube]

Not only that, but the nice folks at Fellow Traveller have invited us over for [url=https://www.ludonarracon.com/about][b]LudoNarraCon 2025[/b][/url] - their digital Steam event celebrating wonderful narrative games - and we’re excited to be launching our game to coincide with the kick off for the event. 

Of course if you want a taste now,[b] [url=http://s.team/a/2460550/]a demo for despelote is now available for Steam Next Fest[/url][/b]. This demo will be the opening minutes of the game where you will begin to explore Quito and get up to some mischief. [b]Your save data from the demo will carry over to the final game[/b]. If you want to stay fresh on the story for May 1st feel free to pass on the demo, but do tell a friend who may have never heard of despelote, it really makes a difference! 

That’s all, we will see you on May 1st!

notes.title: despelote is getting a demo for Steam Next Fest + we got 4 IGF noms?!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

It is now early 2025 and we’re going to have a lot of updates on despelote for you in the coming months. 🙂

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43839262/c2e07589f0ce1fef27dafe06a4183981b6e24300.png[/img]

First, we’re excited to announce that [b]despelote will be getting a public demo for Steam Next Fest![/b] This demo will be the game's opening minutes where you will begin to explore Quito and get up to some mischief. [b]Your save data from the demo will carry over to the final game. [/b]

That said, if you’re already sold on despelote and want to take it all in fresh once the game is out, we promise you the wait isn’t going to be very long (more to come soon 👀). Still, it would mean a lot if you could spread the word about the demo to folks who maybe have never heard of our game, it’s super appreciated and makes a huge difference.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43839262/993bb00c739a1453d340c65ccb1444d3a529ab5a.jpg[/img]

Second, and this was totally unexpected, [url=https://variety.com/2025/gaming/news/consume-me-despelote-independent-games-festival-awards-nominations-gdc-1236275127/]we were nominated for 4 Independent Game Festival awards?! [/url]- including the Seumas Mcnally Grand Prize. It’s honestly pretty hard to believe, but yeah, we will be in San Francisco on March 19th for the IGF awards with all of the awesome nominees (shout out to our publisher buds @ Coal Supper for Thank Goodness You’re Here!) wish us luck.

Now, before our demo releases on Feb 24th, we will have one more big piece of news for you. Keep an eye out. 

That’s all for now!
